beats.event: Rich but bitter Scrooge rebuffs nephew Fred and dismisses charity solicitors
Grudgingly grants clerk Bob Cratchit Christmas Day off
Marley's chained ghost warns him to change or share his fate
Ghost of Past shows lonely boyhood at boarding school
Revisits beloved sister Fan and Fezziwig's joyful Christmas party
Watches fiancee Belle leave him over his obsession with money
Sees Belle now happy with another family, without him
Ghost of Present shows warm Christmas revels and Fred's party
Witnesses Cratchit feast; meets fragile, cheerful Tiny Tim
Warned Tiny Tim will die unless circumstances change
Ghost reveals wretched children Ignorance and Want
Future: a disliked man's funeral; servants pilfer his possessions
Witnesses the Cratchits grieving over Tiny Tim's death
Sees his own name on the tombstone; pledges desperately to change
Wakes transformed on Christmas morning; donates generously to charity
Sends a turkey to the Cratchits and celebrates at Fred's party
Raises Cratchit's wages; becomes a second father to Tiny Tim
